title: Design, Analysis and Breedbase Storage of Plant Breeding Trials
text: Design analysis augmented plant breeding trials. Augmented row-column designs (Piepho Williams, 2016): unreplicated entries plus replicated checks rows, columns superimposed blocks. Row column groups can unequal, blocks can hold number check plots, checks placed D-optimal search (covering Latin rectangles regular layouts). Analyses can use random blocks, random entries (BLUPs), ‘SpATS’ spatial model. Augmented p-rep designs (Williams, Piepho Whitaker, 2011): multi-location, partially replicated trials incomplete blocks pairs entries share block . Choose construction method: flexible randomized "search", paper’s partial alpha-array construction ("alpha"), augmented alpha(2)-array construction ("alpha2"). augmented_prep_parameters() lists feasible settings, every design reports efficiency factor. Resolvable row-column designs (Williams, John Whitaker, 2006): fully replicated trials rows columns within replicates, optimized row-column spatial (linear variance) efficiency, latinized options; analyses RC, LV + RC AR + RC models REML. Analysis: ANOVA degrees freedom estimable observed plots, plus adjusted entry means (BLUEs) standard errors, mean SED 5% LSD. p-rep analyses fit replicates within locations can add fixed random (REML) genotype--location interaction. two-stage analysis (analyze_augmented_prep_two_stage()) handles heterogeneous error variances across locations optional spatial adjustment ‘SpATS’. Field maps ‘Breedbase’: plot-level field book upload files, save design directly Breedbase breeding program folder BrAPI save_breedbase(), checking location accessions breedbase_check(). harvest, save phenotypic data plot trait name save_breedbase_phenotypes() (sheet phenotype_template()), analysis results: first-stage plot values trait field plots (save_breedbase_first_stage()) second-stage genotype means Breedbase analysis (save_breedbase_analysis()). agricolae designs: generate design CRAN package agricolae, convert record trial information prepare_breedbase_trial(), use save_breedbase() phenotype_template() workflow. Multi-environment tools: read ‘Breedbase’ phenotype files, run Hartley’s Fmax variance check, group environments GxE.

title: Analyze a resolvable row-column trial with RC, LV + RC or AR + RC models — analyze_resolvable_row_column
text: Fits variance models Williams, John Whitaker (2006) residual maximum likelihood (REML), replicates treatments fixed: $$E(y) = R\pi + X\tau,\quad var(y) = \sigma^2 V.$$ model = "rc" standard resolvable row-column mixed model: \(V = + \eta_R P_R + \eta_C P_C\), .e. random rows columns within replicates. model = "lv" two-dimensional linear variance model (LV + RC, Eq. 2): \(V = + \eta_R P_R + \eta_C P_C - (\phi_R F_R + \phi_C F_C +     \phi_{RC} F_{RC})\), LV matrices plots row, column, neither. lv_terms chooses \(\phi\) terms fitted equal_phi = TRUE uses one \(\phi\) rows columns (square plots). model = "ar" Rows columns plus separable first-order autoregressive process (AR + RC, Eq. 4): \(V = + \eta_R P_R + \eta_C P_C + \psi D(\rho_C) \otimes     D(\rho_R)\) within replicates. every model identity term independent error ("nugget"). compare = TRUE nested sequence RC, LV one \(\phi\), LV \(\phi_R, \phi_C\), LV \(\phi_{RC}\) well, AR + RC fitted compared REML deviance (likelihood-ratio tests nested LV terms, AIC), sequential fitting process paper recommends deciding whether spatial terms needed.

text: Builds resolvable row-column design v <= k * s treatments r replicates, k x s array rows columns contains every treatment (Williams, John Whitaker, 2006). design found search swaps treatments within replicates: average efficiency factor resolvable row-column design (rows columns within replicates), together efficiency factors component row design column design, maximized. spatial = TRUE, spatial average efficiency factor two-dimensional linear variance (LV + RC) model maximized keeping three efficiency factors step 1 within efficiency_tolerance optimized values. spreads treatments edge interior plots row column neighbours, without needing prior values spatial parameters. replicates contiguous, latinize = TRUE builds latinized design: treatment appears twice long column (replicates stacked vertically) long row (replicates side side), within every group latin_t adjacent replicates (t-latinized designs; John Williams, 1998).
